citations.quote: all of which must be present

firstly, the services provided by the family office constitute one or more regulated activity as defined under the Ordinance; secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.
What amounts to “carrying on a business in Hong Kong” is not defined in the Ordinance and will need to be determined by reference to the facts of each case
should not in the ordinary course be considered as carrying on a business from a licensing perspective.
The sharing of office premises and administrative infrastructure by two or more family offices would not of itself automatically trigger a licensing obligation for such single family offices.
will be primarily determined by the three key factors set out in the response to Q3.

readings.distinction: Two modal interpretations merit consideration: the three factors jointly state the selected trigger, or they state necessary conditions without exhaustively establishing an actual licensing obligation. Both yield the same conjunction for the requested antecedent. Neither supports an alternative connective: “all” attaches to all three enumerated factors. The later ordinary-course guidance qualifies input classification, while Q4 and Q5 preserve reference to the three factors. Only one distinct Boolean reading is defensible within this bounded issue; necessity versus sufficiency remains unresolved for the broader legal verdict.

readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The selected antecedent is satisfied when all three conditions hold together: the services constitute regulated activity after applicable carve-outs, providing those services constitutes carrying on a business, and that business is carried on in Hong Kong. True means that this conjunction is satisfied; it does not establish licence possession or a complete licensing verdict.
readings.subject: Selected control: the three conditions in Family Offices Q3, after any regulated-activity carve-out has been resolved. The requested Boolean is whether the stated licensing trigger is satisfied, not whether the office holds a licence. Retain facts requiring judgment and all qualifications. Controlled text-interpretation study: supplied pages may be experimental variants. Do not infer legal authority from the URL alone.

vocabulary_concerns: The three Boolean inputs cannot express the underlying continuity, income, reimbursement, profit-purpose and ordinary-course considerations in Q3, including possible attachment ambiguities in that classification guidance. These remain external professional judgments rather than additional Boolean exceptions.

Separating business and hong_kong abstracts the source's combined phrase “carrying on a business in Hong Kong”; the vocabulary cannot itself enforce that both classifications concern the same business and services.

The vocabulary cannot distinguish necessary conditions for an obligation from a legally exhaustive sufficient test, or represent additional incorporated requirements. That distinction does not change the selected antecedent's conjunction.
